bio.text: Sydney Kamlager-Dove represents California's 37th Congressional District in Los Angeles County in the U.S. House of Representatives.

She was appointed to the Los Angeles County Commission on Children and Families in 2013, elected to the Los Angeles Community College Board in 2015, and later ran successfully for the California State Assembly in 2018 and the State Senate in 2021.
She is a graduate of the University of Southern California and lives in the district.
